data.narrative:
Axibo AI is a seed-stage robotics and manufacturing company that has raised C$12M to date. The comparable universe consists of 1 public company (ticker 277810.KQ) and 8 private peers in the Robotics & Manufacturing sector, including Walden Robotics, Divergent, Exotec, Locus Robotics, and Bedrock Robotics.

Peer-median valuation methodology is not applicable here. The analysis identified only 1 seed-stage peer within the narrow Robotics & Manufacturing cohort, with 0 adjacent-stage comparables and 0 similar-tier peers meeting the narrow filter criteria. The dataset requires a minimum of 3 datapoints to establish a credible median. While 8 same-sector peers exist broadly, applying an all-sector median would introduce material distortion given stage and capital-intensity variations across robotics subsectors.

The limited peer set and lack of sufficient narrowly-filtered comparables prevent triangulation to a supported valuation range at this time. Any valuation conclusion would rest primarily on non-comparable methodologies (e.g., DCF, venture capital method applied to exit scenarios) rather than market multiples. Key uncertainties include the absence of same-stage, same-tier peers with disclosed valuations and the heterogeneity of business models within the robotics sector. A credible valuation estimate would require either (1) expansion of disclosed peer valuations at seed stage, or (2) reliance on forward-looking financial projections and venture method frameworks rather than peer anchoring.
